text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But... I've also learned a lot!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's not just about running without
restraint. I have
to run smarter... That's
what I learned from
chasing Sei!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna catch up to her... I'll keep
getting
stronger and stronger!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week makes it through her
battle with
Seiun Sky and grows in leaps
and bounds.
